Client examples

Create a client, then call the retry helper.

def retry(attempts):
    for number in range(attempts):
        print("attempt", number)
    return attempts

Install the package first.

$ pip install example-client

The server answers with this status line.

GET /v1/items?limit=10 HTTP/1.1
HTTP/1.1 200 OK <ok>

The import block below uses highlight markup.

import asyncio
async def main():
    return 1

The response body is JSON.

{"status": "ok", "items": []}
